title: The Aliens Changed Humanity Forever
description:
When mysterious aliens arrive on Earth, they bring peace, end war, and eliminate disease. But as humanity embraces its new rulers, a hidden purpose behind their mission slowly emerges—one that will change the fate of the human race forever.

Movie: Childhood's End (2015)
